title: COSHUMA full affiliate program audit for all registered tools

payload.goal: Audit EVERY currently registered COSHUMA tool and identify every legitimate zero-cost affiliate/referral/partner monetization path so the full catalog can be monetized wherever such a program exists.
requirements: Read the current main-branch tool dataset first and derive the exact current tool count and IDs; do not assume 151 if main differs.

For EVERY registered tool without exception, search official sources first for affiliate/referral/partner programs. Record official source URL/evidence, program status, network/provider, commission model, cookie duration, payout threshold/method if public, application URL, country/eligibility restrictions, maintenance requirements, and whether joining is free.
Classify each tool as approved_tracking, applied_pending, rejected, blocked_platform_bug, program_exists_not_applied, no_program_found, program_closed, or needs_manual_verification.
Never count a generic homepage/pricing/signup URL as an affiliate link.
Preserve known verified states for Taskade, Systeme.io, Fliki and current pending/rejected/blocked programs unless fresher official evidence changes them.
Prioritize ordering by expected monetization value, but DO NOT stop at a top-N list. Produce an actionable queue covering every tool for which a legitimate program exists.
Return a complete per-tool structured inventory plus an ordered application queue containing ALL eligible not-yet-applied programs.
Zero cost only; no paid tools; no production writes; no account applications in this research task.

progress_updates.commission: 10%-20% per referral; exact commission period depends on affiliate partner group
progress_updates.payout_terms: Verified and paid the month after commission is earned; official page example says February commissions available March 16
progress_updates.evidence_summary: Official QuillBot affiliate page states free signup, 30-day cookie, PartnerStack tracking, personal referral URL after approval, and up to 20% commission.

progress_updates.commission: 30% of referred customer payments for 12 months
progress_updates.payout_terms: PayPal; commissions have an initial 30-day hold and are processed within 7 business days after becoming due; no minimum payout threshold
progress_updates.eligibility: Available globally with exceptions for countries/regions where BoldDesk cannot do business with the United States
progress_updates.evidence_summary: Official BoldDesk affiliate page states free signup, 30% commission for 12 months, 90-day cookie, Rewardful portal, and PayPal payout terms.

progress_updates.commission: 20%-30% recurring for the lifetime of each referred paid customer, tiered by number of paid customers
progress_updates.payout_terms: PayPal or Stripe; typically paid on the 13th of each month
progress_updates.eligibility: Affiliate program does not require being a Brand24 customer; designed for content creators, marketers, bloggers, website owners and influencers
progress_updates.evidence_summary: Official Brand24 Partner Program page states free participation, 20%-30% lifetime recurring commissions, 90-day cookies, and PayPal/Stripe payouts.

progress_updates.eligibility: Must be at least 18 years old and accept TextCortex partner legal terms
progress_updates.evidence_summary: Current official TextCortex partner legal terms confirm an affiliate program operated through Rewardful and issuance of a unique referral link. Current commission rate/cookie/payout values were not stated on that legal page, so they remain unknown rather than inferred from older marketing content.

progress_updates.commission: 15% commission on purchases made within 365 days of a referral's first click while the affiliate account is active
progress_updates.payout_terms: PayPal only; $10 minimum threshold; payment period between the 1st and 15th of each month after the 30-day seasoning period
progress_updates.eligibility: Official 2026 affiliate page currently says TubeBuddy is not accepting new affiliates
progress_updates.evidence_summary: Official TubeBuddy affiliate page currently states new affiliate applications are not being accepted. Current official program terms retain 15% attribution/commission terms, 365-day window, PayPal-only payout and $10 threshold for existing affiliates.

progress_updates.commission: 25% recurring on every subscription payment for the referral's first year
progress_updates.evidence_summary: Sudowrite's official site links to its current affiliate page, which states 25% recurring commission for every subscription payment during the referral's first year and provides a current Airtable signup link. Cookie/payout/free-to-join terms were not stated on the current program page and remain unknown.
